description: EKINGLUX E6C0805WWAY1UDA(1.1T M) — warm-white 0805 SMD indicator LED, 2800–3200 K, 3.0 V at 20 mA, 120° viewing angle.
name: e6c0805wway1uda-1-1t-m

provenance.source: EasyEDA import from LCSC C6916225; package, pin 1 cathode/pin 2 anode, 2800–3200 K temperature, 3 V/20 mA ratings reviewed against the LCSC product page and attached datasheet.

watch_out_for: This is a polarity-sensitive LED: footprint pad 1 is cathode and pad 2 is anode. The reviewed color-temperature bin is 2800–3200 K; do not substitute a generic white LED when warm white is required.
